nodes.description: Address of the contract owner stored by Ownable; set in constructor and updated in transferOwnership.
Address receiving minted BSP tokens; changeable only by owner via changeDistributor.
ERC20Basic reference to the BSP token contract used for balance checks and transfers.
Constant 630000000 * 10**18 total reward pool locked for mining.
Constant mining duration of 4 years used in mintableAmount calculations.
Fixed array [40,20,20,20] of yearly mining rate percentages.
Boolean flag indicating whether mining has been started.
Timestamp from which mining starts; set in startMining.
Cumulative amount of tokens already minted; used in mintableAmount and totalBspAmount.
Ownable constructor that assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
Owner-only function that transfers ownership of the contract to newOwner.
Modifier function requiring msg.sender to equal owner.
Owner-only function validating _startTime against block.timestamp and enabling mining.
Owner-only function that updates the distributor address.
whenStarted function that computes the mintable amount, increases minted and transfers tokens to distributor.
View function computing currently mintable tokens based on startTime, duration, miningRate and block.timestamp.
View function returning the contract BSP balance plus the already minted amount.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
Modifier function requiring started == true and startTime <= block.timestamp.
Library function performing checked multiplication.
Library function performing division.
Library function performing checked subtraction.
Library function performing checked addition.
Library function asserting the result of token.transfer(to, value).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and initialization.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for mining schedule checks and calculations.
State update minted = minted.add(unminted) in mint, an arithmetic operation on balances.
External call BSPToken.transfer(to, value) made from safeTransfer, executing untrusted token code.
Arithmetic on block.timestamp.sub(startTime) divided by years and days to derive currentYear/currentDay.
Timestamp dependent requires on _startTime vs block.timestamp and block.timestamp + 60 days.
Parameter of transferOwnership naming the new owner address.
Parameter of startMining specifying the mining start timestamp.
Parameter of changeDistributor specifying the new distributor address.
ERC20Basic token parameter of safeTransfer.
Recipient address parameter of safeTransfer.
Amount parameter of safeTransfer.
Local variable holding the mintable amount computed inside mint.
Local variable holding the number of whole years elapsed since startTime.
Local variable holding the days elapsed within the current year.
Local accumulator of the mintable reward for the elapsed period.
Loop index used while summing yearly mining rates.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor reads msg.sender for initialization.
owner is assigned directly from msg.sender.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner as an access restriction.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership execution.
onlyOwner modifier guards startMining execution.
onlyOwner modifier guards changeDistributor execution.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership logic.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into owner.
_startTime is the input parameter of startMining.
_startTime is stored into startTime.
startMining writes the startTime state variable.
startMining sets started to true.
startMining validates _startTime against block.timestamp bounds (timestamp dependency).
startMining executes timestamp dependent require checks.
block.timestamp is consumed by the timestamp checks in startMining.
startMining checks BSPToken.balanceOf(this) against rewardAmount.
changeDistributor writes the distributor state variable.
_newDistributor is the input parameter of changeDistributor.
_newDistributor is stored into distributor.
whenStarted reads the started flag.
whenStarted compares startTime with block.timestamp.
whenStarted is gated on block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
whenStarted modifier wraps mint execution.
mint calls mintableAmount to compute the amount to mint.
mintableAmount result is assigned to the local variable unminted.
unminted is used by mint for accounting and transfer.
mintableAmount reads the started flag.
mintableAmount reads startTime for schedule math.
mintableAmount uses the duration constant.
mintableAmount uses rewardAmount in reward computations.
mintableAmount uses miningRate entries for the reward schedule.
mintableAmount subtracts already minted tokens.
mintableAmount reads BSPToken.balanceOf(this).
mintableAmount derives elapsed time from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
mintableAmount performs timestamp based arithmetic to derive year and day values.
block.timestamp feeds the year/day arithmetic.
currentYear is computed inside mintableAmount.
currentDay is computed inside mintableAmount.
currentMintable accumulates the reward inside mintableAmount.
loop index i is controlled inside mintableAmount.
mintableAmount calls SafeMath.mul for reward math.
mintableAmount calls SafeMath.div for rate scaling.
mintableAmount calls SafeMath.sub on minted.
mintableAmount calls SafeMath.add to accumulate rewards.
currentYear indexes miningRate and bounds the summation loop.
currentMintable is returned as the mintable amount.
mint reads the minted state variable for accumulation.
mint uses distributor as the transfer recipient.
mint uses BSPToken for the outgoing transfer.
mint performs the minted = minted.add(unminted) balance update.
The arithmetic update writes the minted state variable.
mint calls SafeMath.add for the minted update.
mint invokes SafeERC20.safeTransfer to send tokens.
safeTransfer performs the external call token.transfer(to, value).
The external token transfer can re-enter mint while it is executing.
Tokens are sent to the distributor address through the external call.
token parameter is used by safeTransfer.
to parameter is used by safeTransfer.
value parameter is used by safeTransfer.
unminted is forwarded as the value of the transfer.
totalBspAmount reads BSPToken.balanceOf(this).
totalBspAmount adds the minted state variable.
Fallback function rejects all direct ether transfers by reverting.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter used only inside transferOwnership, so it is merged into that function.
_startTime is a parameter used only inside startMining, so it is merged into that function.
_newDistributor is a parameter used only inside changeDistributor, so it is merged into that function.
token is a parameter of SafeERC20.safeTransfer, so it is merged into that function.
to is a parameter of SafeERC20.safeTransfer, so it is merged into that function.
value is a parameter of SafeERC20.safeTransfer, so it is merged into that function.
unminted is a local variable of mint holding the computed amount, so it is merged into mint.
currentYear is a local variable computed in mintableAmount, so it is merged into that function.
currentDay is a local variable computed in mintableAmount, so it is merged into that function.
currentMintable is the local accumulator of mintableAmount, so it is merged into that function.
loop index i exists only inside mintableAmount, so it is merged into that function.
